test_intent: Verifies that ServiceChatDispatcher.ShouldSendToAdminChat returns true for AiDetectData notification type, confirming correct admin vs. log chat routing.
reason: Clean unit test with a meaningful state assertion on a real routing contract. Tests the type-based dispatch switch that determines where AI detection notifications are sent. Low maintenance, no fragile infrastructure. The assertion (result is true) is the correct behavior to verify.

reason: Straightforward unit test with two meaningful state assertions (add returns true, IsSuspicious returns true). Tests core add+query behavior of the suspicious users in-memory storage. No mocks, no fragile infrastructure. Pure unit test at the correct seam.

reason: Edge case test for userId=0. Low production value since Telegram never produces zero user IDs, but verifies the storage is defensive about edge inputs. Simple, no fragile infrastructure. Worth keeping as a lightweight defensive check rather than deleting.

test_intent: Verifies that adding a suspicious user with a negative userId succeeds, testing edge case handling.
reason: Edge case test for negative userId. Low production value since Telegram user IDs are always positive. Same pattern as zero userId test. Simple defensive check with no fragile infrastructure. Worth keeping as lightweight coverage.

test_intent: Verifies that adding a suspicious user with an empty reason string succeeds, testing edge case handling.
reason: Edge case test for empty reason string in SuspiciousUserInfo. Low production value since production code always provides actual reasons. Simple defensive check with meaningful assertions. No fragile infrastructure. Worth keeping as lightweight edge coverage.

reason: Edge case test for null element in the reason list. Low production value since production code always provides non-null reasons. Simple defensive check with meaningful state assertions. No fragile infrastructure. Worth keeping as lightweight null-tolerance coverage.

reason: Tests a meaningful business rule: duplicate add returns false. Three assertions (first returns true, second returns false, user still queryable). This is the strongest test in the SuspiciousUsersStorage suite and protects a real storage invariant. Clean unit test at the correct seam.

reason: Edge case test for removing a user that was never added. Low production value but verifies the storage doesn't throw on missing keys. Simple defensive check with meaningful assertions. No fragile infrastructure. Worth keeping as lightweight no-op coverage.
